name: ZclockID Enterprise v1.1.0
summary: Ensure dynamic reactive color switching for Firewall toggle (bold red when OFF, vibrant green when ON)
notes:
### What's Changed in v1.1.0:
* **Reactive Dynamic Toggle Colors:** Added programmatic DOM class management (`updateFirewallToggleVisual`) so the firewall toggle track instantaneously changes to bold red (`bg-rose-600`) when OFF and vibrant green (`bg-emerald-600`) when ON with matching reactive status badges upon user click and live state poll.
